scope: Proposition 10.1 (Vacuum endpoint) of the manuscript “Cap-selected amplitudes and triangle chords for honeycomb walks” (preprints/Cap-selected-amplitudes-and-triangle-chords-for-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7fd6eb0adc06ad82), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 56. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every N ≥ 1 and every multiset ξ1, . . . , ξN > 0, there is a unique monic real polynomial P0 of degree N such that H = BP0 has the missing modes. The zeros of P0 are positive and simple. Write these zeros as e−2yj , with y1 < · · · < yN , set tj = iyj, and put Hj(z) = H(qjz). For K ∈ C∗, the normalized scalar TQ expression for these roots is the rational function FK(z) := L(w) dfull(w) = KH1H6 + H5H0 + K−1H4H7 H7H6 . (10.1) It satisfies Fi ≡ 1 and Dj = −i for all j. More precisely, with p, r as in Section 9, define Tξ(y) = N X a=1 Z y−ηa −∞ p(v) dv + N X k=1 Z y−yk −∞ r(v) dv. The second sum includes the self term. Then Tξ(yj) = j − 1 2 + 1 4, 1 ≤ j ≤ N.
